meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求转化为可执行的多步骤计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在动手编码前拆解复杂任务并制定执行步骤
copy.tagline_en: Turn requirements into actionable multi-step plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decompose complex tasks and create execution steps before coding

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的需求或规范，自动生成一份详细的实现计划，包括文件修改、代码示例、测试步骤和提交指南。计划按小任务组织，每步2-5分钟，确保完整且可执行。
howto.when: 当你给出一个多步骤任务的规范或需求（如功能说明、API设计等），并在编写代码之前，就可以要求 Claude 生成实现计划。

say.text: 请为这个用户登录功能编写实现计划。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含文件结构、测试和代码的逐步计划。

say.text: 我需要实现一个数据导出模块，先帮我写计划。
say.note: Plan 会覆盖文件修改、测试和提交步骤。

say.text: 根据这份API规范，生成实现计划。
say.note: Claude 会解析规范并分解成可执行的任务。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a detailed implementation plan based on your specification or requirements, including which files to modify, code examples, test steps, and commit instructions. The plan is organized into bite-sized tasks (2-5 minutes each) with actual content, not placeholders.
howto.when_en: When you provide a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before writing code. It is triggered by user request to create an implementation plan.

say_en.text: Write an implementation plan for this user login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a plan with file structure, tests, and code.

say_en.text: I need an implementation plan for a data export module.
say_en.note: The plan will cover file changes, tests, and commits.

say_en.text: Generate an implementation plan based on this API spec.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the spec and break it into actionable tasks.
